drain_mode.description: "continuous" when at least one classifier-proven restart-safe run was preserved and re-adopted across the restart; unproven runs may still have drained for the full deadline first, so this does not mean zero drain wait occurred. "drain" when no run was preserved: every active run completed, drained, or was explicitly interrupted before restart. Use readopted_run_ids for the exact preserved set.

drain_duration_ms.description: Total monotonic drain-phase cost in milliseconds, from phase entry through active-run classification, preservation attestation, and any drain wait; this is not only wait time. Restart, health verification, install pruning, and receipt publication are excluded. On a failure receipt, 0 can also mean the drain phase was never entered; drain_mode does not disambiguate that case.
